description:
Chunk E cannot be planned against the corpus as it stands: the deepest recorded layout is three panes at two levels, captured as a side effect of the lifecycle scenario. Deciding where geometry comes from - session.snapshot rects, layout.export's BSP tree, or a reconstruction - needs a recording with mixed directions and real nesting to check any design against.

Blocks a_26BJGL7VZ more than it looks: a design checked against one split level is a design checked against nothing.
title: 🌲 Record a nested layout deeper than one split
